properties.title: Penrhys Car Park (Start)
properties.description: Start at the car park on the Penrhys plateau, right by the imagined stage finish.

properties.title: Our Lady of Penrhys Shrine
properties.description: A site of pilgrimage since medieval times, with a modern statue marking the original shrine.

properties.title: Panoramic Viewpoint
properties.description: The high point of the walk, with sweeping views down both the Rhondda Fawr and Rhondda Fach valleys.

properties.title: Woodland Path Junction
properties.description: The route dips through a stretch of young woodland before turning back towards the start.

properties.title: Return Descent
properties.description: A gentle descent back towards the plateau, with Tylorstown and Ferndale visible below.

properties.title: Penrhys Car Park (Finish)
properties.description: Loop complete, back at the car park.

properties.title: Reserve Entrance (Start)
properties.description: Enter the Cwm Clydach National Nature Reserve, close to the route near Llwynypia.

properties.title: Ancient Oak Woodland
properties.description: One of the largest surviving ancient oak woodlands in the Rhondda valleys.

properties.title: Clydach Brook Crossing
properties.description: A footbridge crosses the brook that gives the reserve its name.

properties.title: Bird Hide
properties.description: A quiet spot to watch woodland birds, including regular sightings of woodpeckers.

properties.title: Meadow Path
properties.description: An open meadow section rich in wildflowers through the summer months.

properties.title: Reserve Entrance (Finish)
properties.description: Loop complete, back at the entrance.

properties.title: Treherbert Trailhead (Start)
properties.description: Begin at the head of the Rhondda Fawr, where the imagined stage route also climbs.

properties.title: Lower Ridge Ascent
properties.description: A steady climb onto open moorland, with the valley falling away behind you.

properties.title: Bwlch Summit (KOM)
properties.description: The high point of the ridge, right at the mountain pass the stage route crosses between the two valleys (~550m).

properties.title: Descent Toward Maerdy
properties.description: An exposed descent with wide views down the Rhondda Fach towards Maerdy and Ferndale.

properties.title: Maerdy Trailhead (Finish)
properties.description: Finish at Maerdy, at the head of the Rhondda Fach.

properties.title: Reservoir Car Park (Start)
properties.description: Start at the car park by Llyn Fawr, a short detour above Treherbert near Rhigos.

properties.title: Dam Wall Viewpoint
properties.description: Views along the dam wall across the reservoir to the mountains beyond.

properties.title: Northern Shoreline
properties.description: A quiet stretch of shoreline path, popular with anglers and birdwatchers.

properties.title: Rhigos Mountain Views
properties.description: Open views towards the Rhigos mountain road and the Brecon Beacons beyond.

properties.title: Eastern Path
properties.description: The path curves back along the eastern shore towards the car park.

properties.title: Reservoir Car Park (Finish)
properties.description: Loop complete, back at the car park.

properties.title: Heritage Park Entrance (Start)
properties.description: Start at the former Lewis Merthyr Colliery site at Trehafod, near the stage start at Pontypridd.

properties.title: Lewis Merthyr Colliery Headframe
properties.description: The preserved pithead winding gear, a landmark of the Rhondda's mining heritage.

properties.title: Fan House & Museum
properties.description: Home to the colliery's original ventilation fan house, now part of the museum.

properties.title: Riverside Path
properties.description: A level, family-friendly stretch alongside the Rhondda river.

properties.title: Heritage Park Entrance (Finish)
properties.description: Loop complete, back at the entrance.

properties.title: Maerdy Forest Car Park (Start)
properties.description: Start above Maerdy at the head of the Rhondda Fach, close to where the route crosses the mountain pass.

properties.title: Forestry Viewpoint
properties.description: A clearing in the forestry plantation with views back down the valley.

properties.title: Old Tramroad Path
properties.description: The walk follows the route of a disused mountain tramroad for a short stretch.

properties.title: Mountain Stream Crossing
properties.description: A small stepping-stone crossing over a mountain stream.

properties.title: Maerdy Forest Car Park (Finish)
properties.description: Loop complete, back at the car park.
